answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors. What survives to the velvet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the mesa until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the terrace of the next round. Written in a bullet-like short clauses, then a summary line register, it stays short.
